_doc: #1708 the terminal's native tools, shipped as lib*.so under jniLibs/<abi>/ and run from applicationInfo.nativeLibraryDir, the one place an app at targetSdk >= 29 may exec from (W^X). They are the very files the terminal plugin used to download into the app's data dir at the F-Droid flavour (Terminal.js), from the same upstreams, now fetched at BUILD time by tools/fetch-native-tools.py and refused unless the sha256 matches. Never committed: licence-boundaries keeps *.so out of the tree. libproot-xed.so = proot, libproot.so / libproot32.so = proot's loaders (PROOT_LOADER / PROOT_LOADER32 in init-sandbox.sh), libtalloc.so = its library (linked as libtalloc.so.2 at start), libaxs.so = the axs terminal server (ProcessManager links $PREFIX/axs to it). proot and talloc are GPL-2.0 / LGPL, sources: https://github.com/proot-me/proot and https://talloc.samba.org/ ; axs: https://github.com/bajrangCoder/acodex_server (MIT).
